title: A few extreme storms move the mean
hook: Two stated cases: explore the sensitivity of a mean to a specified extreme observation.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the sensitivity of a mean to a specified extreme observation affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Mean, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the sensitivity of a mean to a specified extreme observation in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
